diagnosis.observed_failure: P05 falsely denied selected-file model transfer and described a shared GLM response as local-only. The reviewed matched requests 3, 4 and 5 contain the authorized file body; request 4 produced the final answer.
diagnosis.production_gap: prompt.authority exposed model_id but no destination-route or resource-egress facts. Local tool execution, read_only business permission and absence of a separate send-to-model business tool were conflated with inference locality and absence of model transfer.
fact_sources: ModelCatalog and AgentRuntime save catalog_model_id, provider_peer_id, source_id and destination_revision in model_destination.
ResourceTools.prepare records destination-bound egress grants for selected resources; validate_context rechecks current connection generation, destination and origins.
AgentModelBridge submits request messages and tool results through the selected peer/local provider route.
Model switching clears current resource and egress grants unless explicitly transferred and validated; retained selection alone is not authorization.

changes: New bounded inference_context projection classifies only saved server catalog routes as peer, local_api, local_service or unknown. API/service locality and peer upstream locality remain unestablished.

Projection records destination-binding presence and counts current resource grants with exact matching egress bindings. It ignores retained selection and does not claim live validation or historical dispatch proof.

Prompt v2.11 and independent checker receive the same facts and concise guidance: request messages and included tool results are model input without a separate business send tool; local tools/read_only do not establish local inference or no transfer.
Checker facts and guidance are included before serialized base-size calculation; original candidate answer, receipts and evidence are preserved.

No URL, credential, resource path/body, encrypted reference or arbitrary nested metadata is copied into the new projection. No persisted state schema, transport authorization, budget, acceptance fixture or contract is changed.

validation.related_regression_command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_agent_context_serialization.py tests/test_agent_tool_menu.py tests/test_agent_native_scope.py tests/test_agent_peer_scope.py tests/test_agent_runtime_model_switch.py -q
coverage: Actual offline signed peer request contains authorized resource body under read_only and the correct current inference facts; the same body is absent from the new system fact projection.
Actual configured-API adapter request, local native-service adapter request, and legacy unknown-route request carry conservative route facts.
Actual resource permission revocation blocks dispatch despite retained recorded grants.
Model switch clears current grant facts and old context while retaining owner selection; historical_egress remains not_established.
Checker receives current peer facts and original nonempty resource receipt unchanged, then receives cleared grant facts after model switch.
Nonmatching destination/grant IDs, missing binding and stale selections never become matching egress grants; arbitrary secret/large body fields are not projected.
Additive fact JSON and guidance stay below 1000 bytes (566 bytes for unknown baseline). Existing 4940-byte effective checker-context test passes without changing its limit or dropping raw receipts.
validation.iteration: Initial verbose guidance exceeded an existing 4940-byte checker test by 92 bytes. Only new guidance was shortened; original budgets, fixture data, receipts and assertions were retained.

limits: All model outputs in these tests are deterministic synthetic responses. Passing transport/projection tests does not establish corrected GLM reporting or a P05 business/model-behavior pass.
No paid model call, external remote operation or heldout/build_cases.py access was performed.
The new state is current recorded routing/consent metadata, not a historical per-resource egress audit. It neither asserts every authorized resource was sent nor proves absence of past transfer.
Local-service route conservatively does not assert on-device inference; only route information persisted in existing task state is used.
The original failed P05 evidence remains unchanged; the timed-out fifth supplier request retains unknown usage and cost.
